mapper.insert: insert into report (item_id, reporter_id, reason, detail, status) values (#{itemId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: select count(*) from report where item_id = #{itemId} and reporter_id = #{reporterId}

select count(*) from report
and status = #{status}
mapper.update: update report set status = #{status}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select r.*, i.title as itemTitle from report r left join item i on r.item_id = i.id where r.reporter_id = #{userId} order by r.created_at desc
